source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The checked legacy account setup patch turns an Autodiscover401 failure into ExchangeUsernameException and stores it through the discovery error callback. Its all-finished observer exposes the username state only when priority discovery also failed; a successful priority result still wins. The username branch returns before configuration guessing. This landing updates legacy accountSetup.js, and its review explicitly leaves AccountHub for a separate update. At the fixed revision the old path is absent; selected newer FindConfig and AccountHub form/view use an error cause and username state instead. The current module test directly checks missing-versus-separate username authentication, without proving the old parallel UI race or the new view transition. No runtime test ran.
title: Route the legacy Exchange username state after discovery completes
